rules.plant: an adaptive run that never raises M (phase A only, at M_low): it must exceed 0.05 on the sharp cells
incomplete: the never-raise plant does not exceed 0.05 on every sharp cell

rules.capped: the run reaches its cap (10 CPU-h less hr3-pilot's)
